result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major missing image and one minor text truncation issue.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section shows a broken/missing image placeholder for Tokumaru Ramen Bar. The restaurant card displays a grey box with a broken image icon instead of an actual restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image URL is valid and the image asset is properly loaded. Implement a proper fallback image for cases where the restaurant photo fails to load.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section appears to be truncated, cutting off the full name of the restaurant.
issues.suggestion: Either allow text to wrap to a second line, reduce font size, or ensure the card width is sufficient to display the full restaurant name. At minimum, add an ellipsis (...) to indicate the text is truncated.
